insights.title: Insights
insights.description: What the numbers say about your campaigns: unusual changes, KPIs off track and budget pacing, with a suggested next step.
insights.emptyHint: Insights appear when campaign numbers arrive and something stands out.
insights.dismissBody: It stays dismissed while the condition lasts. Tell the team why (optional).
insights.computedNote: Computed by the platform from the campaign's daily numbers.
insights.aiDisclaimer: Written by AI from the numbers above. Check before you act.
insights.noRecommendations: No suggested step for this one — use your judgement.
insights.acceptTitle: Create a task from this step?
insights.acceptBody: A task is added to this client's work with the details, linked back to the insight.
insights.campaignEmpty: Nothing stands out on this campaign right now.
insights.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open insights} one {# open insight} other {# open insights}}

draft.drafted: Draft added — review and edit before publishing
draft.replaceBody: The section already has text. The AI draft will replace it (you can still undo by not saving).
draft.hint: Written from this report's numbers and insights, in the report's language.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Ask about your clients, campaigns, requests, tasks and sales. Answers use only records you can open, with sources.
assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.emptyTitle: What would you like to know?
assistant.emptyHint: The assistant searches the records you have access to and cites them.

suggestions.two: Show high-priority requests that are still open
suggestions.three: Which leads came from lead ads?
suggestions.four: What did our latest reports say?

status.no_sources: I couldn't find anything you have access to about this. Try naming the client, campaign or record.
status.refused: The AI model declined to answer this. Try rephrasing.
status.budget: Your agency has used this month's AI budget.
status.disabled: AI is switched off for your agency.
status.failed: The AI service didn't respond. Try again.

assistant.deleteBody: Its messages are deleted for good.
assistant.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check the sources.
assistant.notEnabledHint: An admin can switch it on in AI settings.

admin.title: AI settings
admin.description: Switch AI on, choose how sensitive insights are, set a monthly budget and manage the assistant's index.
admin.enabledHint: Explanations, report drafts and the assistant call the AI provider. Insights and suggestions are computed by the platform and work either way.
admin.sensitivityHint: How unusual a day has to be before it's flagged.
admin.autoDraftHint: Scheduled report drafts get AI-written commentary and next steps. They stay drafts until someone publishes them.
admin.budgetHint: AI calls stop for the rest of the month when the agency reaches it.

modeHint.mock: A built-in demo provider writes from the platform's own numbers and records. No data leaves the platform.
modeHint.off: Add the missing keys to the environment to use AI.

admin.indexHint: Records the assistant can search. Each person only ever sees results from records they can open.
admin.stale: {count, plural, =0 {Up to date} one {# record to re-index} other {# records to re-index}}
admin.rebuilt: {count, plural, =0 {Index is up to date} one {# record indexed} other {# records indexed}}
admin.dataBody: Only the snippets relevant to a question and the computed numbers are sent to the provider. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses are removed before indexing. Conversations are private to their author.
